title: Atlantic City Electric Rebates 2026: Heat Pump, Appliance, Thermostat
desc: What Atlantic City Electric pays southern New Jersey homeowners in 2026: heat pump rebates $500 to $2,000, up to $10,000 to leave gas, $750 water heater, $150 thermostat and appliance rebates.
h1: Atlantic City Electric Rebates for Homeowners
lead: Atlantic City Electric serves about 547,000 customers across eight counties in southern New Jersey. It splits its home rebates into two tracks: a heating and cooling program for equipment upgrades, and an electrification program for homes leaving gas, oil or propane. Appliances have their own store. These are the 2026 figures from the company's pages, read in a browser on October 6, 2026.
cards_heading: What Atlantic City Electric pays in 2026
cards_intro: The company says its programs depend on available funding. Each card names the fact with the date and source link.

cards.title: Standard heat pump
cards.note: $500 or $750 for a standard air source model by efficiency tier, $750 for a ductless mini-split, and $2,000 for a cold climate model from April 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

cards.title: Electrification: leave gas, oil or propane
cards.note: Up to $10,000 or 50% of project costs for a full switch with a cold climate heat pump, up to $5,000 or 50% for dual fuel, and up to $2,000 or 30% for a partial switch with a standard heat pump.

cards.title: Panels, decommissioning and appliances for switchers
cards.note: Electric panel help up to $4,000 for income-qualified homes or $300 per circuit, removal of the old system at half of the cost up to $2,000, a heat pump dryer $200 and an induction stove $250 ($350 moderate-income).

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: With an HVAC job, for a limited time through June 30, 2027. Energy Wise Rewards adds up to $100.

cards.title: Lower-income bonus
cards.note: Added for low- to moderate-income customers on each qualified piece of equipment.

cards.title: Appliance rebates
cards.note: Dryer up to $300, washer up to $150, refrigerator up to $100, dehumidifier $40, room air conditioner $30, electric lawn equipment $25 to $75. Ends December 31, 2026 or earlier.

sections: The company serves about 547,000 customers in eight counties of southern New Jersey, according to the state's Rate Counsel office. Atlantic City is in that region, but we found no official page that names the city, so confirm the name on your electric bill. Part of Ocean County is also in its territory. If your bill says PSE&G or JCP&L, use the PSE&G page or the JCP&L page.

HVAC equipment and electrical panels go through a licensed contractor who submits online within 90 days of purchase. Indoor appliances and lawn equipment you can submit yourself, also within 90 days, and the company mails a check within 45 days. The company has joint forms for customers who also buy gas rebates from South Jersey Gas, New Jersey Natural Gas or PSE&G gas, so ask the contractor which form to use.

The rebates page says "up to $1,300" for the standard HVAC program, and the appliance page says "up to $750." Neither is the full story. The heat pump line alone reaches $2,000, and the electrification program reaches $10,000. When you compare quotes, add the rows yourself from the tables in the cards above.
What Atlantic City Electric does not pay

We found no home battery rebate or rooftop solar rebate on the pages we read. State solar credits and net metering still apply to solar owners. We also found no weatherization rebate; Comfort Partners covers lower incomes at no cost. The federal credits ended after 2025.
claim_heading: How to claim an Atlantic City Electric rebate
claim_steps: Confirm your electric bill says Atlantic City Electric.
For heating, choose a licensed contractor and ask for both the standard and switching rebates on the quote.
For appliances, buy an ENERGY STAR model and submit the receipt online within 90 days.
Call 1-866-353-0007 or email ACErebates@clearesult.com for help.
Keep invoices, model numbers and photos.
